title: A clause slipped in
description: A most-favoured-customer clause was added after Section 13 and the rest renumbered. The note says nothing changed.

substantive.label: Clause added
substantive.v2_quote: If Provider offers the Service to any other customer of similar size at lower fees during the term, Provider will promptly offer the same fees to Customer and refund the difference for the preceding twelve (12) months.

cosmetic.label: Number formatting
cosmetic.v1_quote: within thirty (30) days after written notice

letter_claims.text: We corrected a few typographical errors.
We updated our notice address in Section 14.
No commercial or legal terms were changed.
No clause was added or removed.
Payment terms remain net thirty days.
